name: Momiji Happy Story
source:
One year after events of prequel. By the time Kazuto graduates from school, he and Momiji get into love relationship. And the two get tied together... like on that day one year ago.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在前作的一年後。和人畢業時，他與椛已經成為戀人。兩人再次緊緊相連……就像一年前的那一天一樣。
